liked_series.label: Series you like
liked_series.description: List several favorites. Include the year or country when a title could be ambiguous.

liked_elements.label: What you liked about them
liked_elements.description: Mention the qualities that mattered; different favorites can have different reasons.
liked_elements.placeholder: Severance's mystery and visual control, Fleabag's voice and brevity…

excluded_series.label: Series to exclude
excluded_series.description: Add shows you disliked, dropped, already watched, or do not want repeated.
excluded_series.placeholder: Already watched Succession; could not get into…

mood_and_genres.label: Mood, themes, or genres
mood_and_genres.description: Describe the viewing experience or subject matter you want now.
mood_and_genres.placeholder: Character-driven mystery with some dark humor…

format_preferences.label: Format preferences
format_preferences.description: Say whether live action, animation, anime, documentary, anthology, or limited series matter.
format_preferences.placeholder: Live action or animation; limited series welcome

commitment.label: Viewing commitment
commitment.description: Note episode length, number of seasons, pacing, finished/ongoing status, or release-schedule preferences.
commitment.placeholder: Prefer completed stories and episodes under an hour…

constraints.label: Limits or deal-breakers
constraints.description: Include content sensitivities, accessibility needs, or other boundaries.
constraints.placeholder: No graphic gore; avoid unresolved cancellation cliffhangers…

availability.label: Region and access
availability.description: Availability changes often, so include your country and services only if it matters.
availability.placeholder: Germany; Netflix, Apple TV+, or rental

recommendation_count.label: Shortlist size
recommendation_count.description: Say how many recommendations you want, or leave blank for a compact shortlist.
